const publicSources = ['https://www.discover.com/personal-loans/', 'https://www.nerdwallet.com/personal-loans', 'https://www.prosper.com/personal-loans']; const fallbacks = { 'https://www.discover.com/personal-loans/': 'Discover Personal Loan

Personal loans with minimum credit score of 680 and monthly income of $4,000.

', 'https://www.nerdwallet.com/personal-loans': 'NerdWallet Personal Loan

Personal loan offers with minimum credit score of 640 and monthly income of $2,500.

', 'https://www.prosper.com/personal-loans': 'Prosper Personal Loan

Personal loans with minimum credit score of 600 and monthly income of $1,800.

' }; const pages = $input.all(); const defaultMode = $items('Source Mode')[0]?.json?.source_mode || 'fixture'; return pages.map((item, index) => { const sourceUrl = String(item.json.source_url || publicSources[index % publicSources.length]); const fetched = String(item.json.product_html ?? item.json.body ?? item.json.data ?? ''); const usedFallback = !fetched.trim(); const raw = usedFallback ? fallbacks[sourceUrl] : fetched; const sourceMode = usedFallback ? 'fixture' : (item.json.source_mode === 'public' || defaultMode === 'public' ? 'public' : 'fixture'); const text = raw.replace(//gi, ' ').replace(//gi, ' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const title = (String(raw).match(/]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i)?.[1] || `Personal Loan ${index + 1}`).replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim(); const sourceIndex = Math.max(0, publicSources.indexOf(sourceUrl)); const digest = require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(raw, 'utf8').digest('hex'); return { json: { product_id: `public-personal-loan-${sourceIndex + 1}`, name: title.slice(0, 255), source_url: sourceUrl, source_mode: sourceMode, product_text: text.slice(0, 12000), retrieved_at: new Date().toISOString(), content_sha256: digest, fallback_used: usedFallback } }; });

parameters.jsCode: const original = $items('Extract Public Criteria Text')[$itemIndex]?.json || {}; let value = $json; if (Array.isArray($json.choices) && $json.choices[0]?.message?.content) value = $json.choices[0].message.content; if (typeof value === 'string') value = JSON.parse(value.replace(/^```json\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/, '')); value = { ...original, ...value }; const allowed = new Set(['min_monthly_income', 'max_monthly_income', 'min_credit_score', 'max_credit_score', 'employment_status', 'min_age', 'max_age']); if (!value.product_id || !value.name) throw new Error('LLM output missing product identity'); if (!value.criteria || typeof value.criteria !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value.criteria)) throw new Error('LLM criteria must be an object'); for (const key of Object.keys(value.criteria)) if (!allowed.has(key)) throw new Error(`unsupported criterion: ${key}`); if (!Array.isArray(value.ambiguous_criteria) || !['high', 'medium', 'low'].includes(value.confidence)) throw new Error('LLM output does not match the product schema'); if (!/^https?:\/\//.test(String(value.source_url))) throw new Error('LLM source_url must be public HTTP(S)'); if (!['fixture', 'public'].includes(value.source_mode)) throw new Error('source_mode must be fixture or public'); return [{ json: { ...value, active: true } }];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO loan_products (product_id, name, criteria, source_url, source_mode, retrieved_at, content_sha256, active) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6::timestamptz, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (product_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, criteria = EXCLUDED.criteria, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, source_mode = EXCLUDED.source_mode, retrieved_at = EXCLUDED.retrieved_at, content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256, active = EXCLUDED.active, updated_at = now() RETURNING product_id, updated_at;
